About

I completed my B.Ed in Education at the Institute of Education and Research, University of Dhaka, and I'm drawn to work that meets children exactly where they are. My six months as an intern teacher at Ramna Special School for Mentally Disabled & Autistic Children gave me hands-on experience adapting instruction to each child's pace, sensory needs, and communication style.

I'm looking to work as a special educator in special schools or with NGOs supporting inclusive education, and I'm equally open to paths in speech or occupational therapy, child psychology, and developmental therapy.

Work Experience

Intern Teacher

Ramna Special School for Mentally Disabled & Autistic Children · 6 months
  • Worked directly with children with intellectual disabilities and autism spectrum disorder, supporting individualized learning plans tailored to each child's developmental needs and pace.
  • Assisted lead educators in delivering classroom instruction, adapting methods and materials to diverse cognitive, sensory, and communication needs.
  • Supported functional life skills, communication, and social-emotional growth through structured, hands-on activities.
  • Helped create a safe, inclusive, supportive environment using patience-driven, behavior-sensitive strategies.
  • Collaborated with teachers and staff to monitor student progress and adjust support strategies.
